verdict.rationale: Smithery's documented 'Triggers' feature lets a consumer subscribe to events surfaced by an MCP server's upstream service, with Smithery proxying the subscribe call and events POSTed directly to the consumer (webhook-style delivery) — a fairly direct match for the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of trigger subscription and delivery, and more detail on how an AI-native user actually invokes/consumes these webhook events end-to-end.
